newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TENNIS-SPAIN'S MARTINEZ WINS KREMLIN CUP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SPAIN'S MARTINEZ WINS KREMLIN CUP.

text.p: Top seed Conchita Martinez of Spain fought off a tough challenge by second seed Barbara Paulus of Austria on Saturday to win the $400,000 womens' Kremlin Cup tournament.
Martinez, the world number three, had to dig deep into her reserves of strength to secure victory after Paulus pulled herself together after taking only one game in the first set.
Paulus, ranked 13th in the world, took the second set 6-4 and kept level with Martinez until 4-4 in the final set before eventually losing it 6-4.
The 24-year-old Spaniard was handed the $67,000 winner's cheque by Steffi Graf, who pulled out of the tournament through injury but came to Moscow to play an exhibition match.
